description: This file defines a Kotlin object 'ProjectRootCheck' which provides a utility function to verify that the current module is the correct Android Gradle root by checking the resolvability of certain resources and logging the results.

classes.name: ProjectRootCheck
classes.description: A Kotlin singleton object serving as a utility to verify project setup by checking resource resolution.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Checks whether specific resources can be resolved, indicating correct project setup, and logs the process. Returns true if resources resolve correctly, false otherwise.
